incidents.name: JumpFarm staking share inflation
incidents.notes: The JUMP staking contract credited sJUMP shares on the pre-fee transfer amount of a fee-on-transfer token, so cycling flash-loaned JUMP through stake/unstake minted more JUMP than was deposited.

sources.ref: onchain review: staking 0x05999eB831ae28Ca920cE645A5164fbdB1D74Fe9 created 2023-08-08T22:39:35Z by 0x4b19466f0c31b3a9fc239ef76ef37ecdc08a2d9f, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (27.6 days). ~2.4 ETH x $1,629.70 at incidentTimestamp 1693917731 (DefiLlama) = $3,911.
